entry.title: New: Resolution 679 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE HŌLUALOA VILLAGE ‘OHANA FOR EXPENSES ASSOCIATED WITH ITS 25TH ANNUAL COFFEE AND ART STROLL

Transfers $2,500 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 7)
